landing.title: See where films are streaming
landing.subtitle: Search any film or series, and see in which countries they are available
landing.setup: Set country & services for tailored results
landing.importBody: Find out which films on your list are streaming, and where to watch them in the world.

header.setupAccessible: {country}, {count, plural, one {# service} other {# services}}. Open settings.
header.setupAccessibleEmpty: Set country and services. Open settings.

footer.credit: Availability data from JustWatch via TMDB.

search.label: Search
search.placeholder: Search a film or a series
search.heading: {count, plural, one {# result for “{query}”} other {# results for “{query}”}}
search.hint: Start typing to see matches. Pick one to open its page.
search.noMatches: No titles found for “{query}”. Check the spelling, or try the original title or fewer words.
search.matches: {count, plural, =0 {No matches} one {# match} other {# matches}}
search.notOnYours: Not streaming on your services in {country}
search.otherCountries: Streaming in {count, plural, one {# other country} other {# other countries}}

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Changes are saved on this device as you make them.
settings.countryHint: You haven’t set your country yet. Choose it to see where films are streaming for you.
settings.servicesEmpty: Choose your country first to see the services available there.
settings.servicesPrompt: Tick the services you subscribe to.
settings.removed: Removed {services}: {count, plural, one {it isn’t} other {they aren’t}} available in {country}.
settings.noService: No service matches “{query}”. Check the spelling or try another name.
settings.planNote: Some services have plans with ads or extra tiers. Pick the service; we’ll point out when a title is only on a specific plan.
settings.watchlistImported: {count, plural, one {# film} other {# films}}, imported {imported}.
settings.watchlistChecked: {count, plural, one {# film} other {# films}}, imported {imported}. Checked {checked}.
settings.removeBody: This deletes the {count, plural, one {# film} other {# films}} saved on this device. You can import your watchlist again from Letterboxd.
settings.everythingBody: Your country, services and recently viewed titles. This clears all data Couch saved on this device.
settings.clearBody: This removes your watchlist, your country and services, and your recently viewed titles from this device. It can’t be undone.

title.shareDescription: See where {title} is streaming in your country and others.

links.open: {title} on {service}, opens in a new tab

homeCard.pickCountry: Pick your country and services to see what you can watch where you are.
homeCard.planOnly: Streaming on {service}, on a specific plan only
homeCard.planDetail: Only on {plans}. Check that your plan includes it.
homeCard.otherServices: It’s streaming here on {count, plural, one {# other service} other {# other services}}, none of them on your list.
homeCard.noStreamData: No streaming data for {country}. It may still be available; our source has nothing for it.
homeCard.noDataBody: This doesn’t mean it isn’t available. We found no streaming, rent or buy information for this title in any country.
homeCard.streamingCount: Streaming on {count, plural, one {# service} other {# services}} in {country}
homeCard.unsetServices: You haven’t chosen your services yet, so none are marked as yours.

otherCountries.label: In other countries
otherCountries.streaming: Streaming on {services, plural, one {# of your services} other {# of your services}} in other {countries, plural, one {# country} other {# countries}}
otherCountries.none: None of your services have it in other countries
otherCountries.alsoCountries: Also streaming in {count, plural, one {# other country} other {# other countries}}
otherCountries.alsoService: Also streaming on {service} in {count, plural, one {# country} other {# countries}}
otherCountries.moreServices: Show {count, plural, one {# more of your services} other {# more of your services}}
otherCountries.dashed: Dashed = only on a specific plan or tier.
otherCountries.streamingIn: Streaming in {count, plural, one {# country} other {# countries}}
otherCountries.showCountries: Show {count, plural, one {# more country} other {# more countries}}
otherCountries.ungroupedHint: Set your services to see these grouped by what you have.
otherCountries.groupedHint: Countries with your services come first. Dashed = only on a specific plan or tier.

loading.title: Looking up this title
loading.body: Checking where it is streaming. This can take a few seconds.

noResults.title: No titles found for “{query}”
noResults.body: Check the spelling, or try the original title or fewer words.

unavailable.title: We couldn’t load this
unavailable.body: The data service isn’t answering right now. Try again in a moment.

busy.title: Lots of people are looking right now
busy.body: We’ve reached a limit with our data source. Try again in a minute.

wrongFile.title: That doesn’t look like a Letterboxd watchlist
wrongFile.body: Export your watchlist from the Letterboxd website and choose that file.

emptyFile.title: This file has no films
emptyFile.body: Check that you exported your Watchlist and not another list.

notFound.title: We couldn’t find that title
notFound.body: The link may be wrong, or the title may have been removed.

dev.cardBody: A card for grouping related content.
dev.disclosureBody: Extra detail sits inside the disclosure.
